title: Synthetic AI Sentiment Tracker (development example)
methodology_notes:
FABRICATED DATA. This study is a synthetic example used for Iris pipeline development. The questionnaire shape is adapted from a discussion draft; subgroup categories, sample sizes, and all reported percentages were invented to be directionally plausible but do not reflect any real fielding.

Introductory script read to all respondents before Q1: "The next few questions are about artificial intelligence, or AI. By 'AI' we mean computer systems that can perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes things like chatbots, image generators, and systems used to make recommendations or decisions."

Mode: online probability panel. Weights raked to ACS / CPS benchmarks on age, gender, education, race/ethnicity, region, and party. Every published percentage in this file is reported under base.kind="all" (non-substantive responses kept in the denominator).
